title: Learning how to Forget: Fine-tuning for Long-Context Sparse Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.19920v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A lot of prior work addressed key-value (KV) cache selection and compression by sparse attention to enable long-context inference for transformer language models without excessive hardware budgets. We provide a new method for fine-tuning models with sparse attention. It works for any KV cache policy, runs on a moderate hardware budget (e.g., a single Nvidia A100 GPU with 40 GB RAM), and allows the model to co-adapt with the policy, often outperforming models trained with exact attention (sequence parallelism). We also provide an efficient implementation of H2O sparse attention (the leading policy in our experiments) with dedicated scaled dot product attention kernel support. KeysAndValues (https://github.com/awslabs/keys_values), a new open source library for long-context inference and fine-tuning, provides easy-to-use and performant code for all methods discussed here.

translated_title: 学习如何遗忘：针对长上下文稀疏注意力的微调方法
translated_abstract: 许多先前的研究通过稀疏注意力机制来解决键值（KV）缓存的选择和压缩问题，从而在不增加过多硬件预算的情况下实现Transformer语言模型的长上下文推理。我们提出了一种新的方法，用于对具有稀疏注意力的模型进行微调。该方法适用于任何KV缓存策略，可在适度的硬件预算（例如，单个具有40 GB内存的Nvidia A100 GPU）上运行，并允许模型与策略共同适应，通常优于使用精确注意力（序列并行）训练的模型。我们还提供了H2O稀疏注意力（我们实验中领先的策略）的高效实现，并配备了专用的缩放点积注意力内核支持。KeysAndValues（https://github.com/awslabs/keys_values）是一个新的开源库，用于长上下文推理和微调，为本文讨论的所有方法提供了易于使用且高性能的代码。
tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于任何KV缓存策略的稀疏注意力微调新方法，能在中等硬件上运行并使模型与策略共同适应，优于精确注意力训练，并提供了高效实现和开源库。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new fine-tuning method for sparse attention that works with any KV cache policy, runs on moderate hardware, enables model co-adaptation with the policy, outperforms exact attention training, and includes an efficient implementation and open-source library.
